notes: Batch 1 «عددهای درست» (v1.11.60) — Groups 01+03 of the grouped audit. (1) F7 (High, release blocker): the 100% useful fill at timer stop now computes its room at BOX level (timerTotal − usefulTotal), capped at the stopped session's seconds — a box with older "useful without a session" (manual real + tick-done) no longer stays at 75% while the session shows 100%. (2) L-PERF1: flushSavesBeacon never beacons while the same kind of POST is in flight (the beacon could overtake the stale POST on the threaded server); it uses the keepalive fetch instead. (3) PR3: the server replaces a stored activeTimer only when the incoming session is the same one (pause/resume) or started later. (4) خ-۷: a gentle beforeunload warning only while a timer is running. (5) M-DATA3: custom boxes without a real YYYY-MM-DD date or valid HH:MM start/end are dropped by server sanitize and client ensureStateMaps, and minutesBetween coerces garbage to 0 so one bad box cannot NaN a day total. (6) L-DATA1: box_api_delete also removes a custom box from custom_boxes, and purgeBoxState now clears its usefulMinutes, timerSessions and testLog rows. (7) L-DATA2: _preserve_corrupt names use milliseconds + a counter. (8) L-DATA3: atomic_write also fsyncs the directory. i18n 1331/1331 (1 new key: tmLeaveWhileRunning).
